There is still a significant gap between machine-level pattern recognition and human-level concept learning. Humans can learn under uncertainty from only a few examples and generalize these concepts to solve new problems. The growing interest in explainable machine intelligence, requires experimental environments and diagnostic tests to analyze weaknesses in existing approaches to drive progress in the field.
